answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 19 epochs. Receipts are issued in sparrow, burned on slash in inlet, and listed in juniper. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 273 aliases cost 274 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
